tags.feature: Progression with Purpose – Explore 9 new maps designed to introduce core mechanics through light storytelling. Game progression now unfolds with purpose.

notes.title: v0.2.2 – Toolkit Expanded
notes.content:
[h3][b]What’s New[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Prepare the Defense[/b] – Turrets no longer auto-reload between waves! Keep your storage stocked and ready, defense now takes real preparation
[*] [b]Single-use Items in Data Core Shops[/b] – No need to learn and craft every tool. Dynamite and other items are now available as single-use purchases directly from the Data Core!
[*] [b]Turret Evolution[/b] – Basic ballistic and energy turrets can now evolve into specialized versions! Just make sure to provide them with an Expansion Kit
[*] [b]More Energy Turrets[/b] – We've expanded your arsenal with more energy turret options. They're now a truly viable part of your defense strategy!
[*] [b]Automation Begins[/b] – Introducing machines that handle auto-crafting and drones that automatically reload your turrets
[*] [b]Achievements Added[/b] – A new set of achievements has arrived. Can you collect them all?
[/list]

[h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]

[i]If you're using Steam Remote Play, make sure to disable Steam Input in the controller settings. Steam Input can cause crashes with controller use and Remote Play at the moment—we're on it, but this should help for now.[/i]

notes.title: v0.1.0 – Foundations Refined
notes.content:
[h3][b]What’s New[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]UI Overhaul[/b] – The whole interface got a smoother, cleaner redesign. Easier to use, easier on the eyes
[*] [b]Gameplay Improvements[/b] – Core gameplay has been streamlined. Includes 16 craftable recipes to experiment with!
[*] [b]New Perks[/b] – We added 17 new perks to shake things up and give you more flexibility in your playstyle
[*] [b]Visual Improvement [/b]– Improved lighting, visuals, and better camera behavior to make everything feel more polished
[/list]

[h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]

[i]If you're using Steam Remote Play, make sure to disable Steam Input in the controller settings. Steam Input can cause crashes with controller use and Remote Play at the moment—we're on it, but this should help for now.[/i]
